stock.description: As an investment holding company, Guan Chao Holdings Limited primarily deals in the sale of both parallel-imported and second-hand vehicles within the Singaporean market. Its comprehensive offerings also encompass vehicle financing and insurance brokerage, motor vehicle leasing solutions, and the retailing of automotive parts and accessories. Established in 1989, the firm's headquarters are located in Singapore.
